Class PracticeSession

java.lang.Object
aslframework.game.session.AbstractGameSession
aslframework.game.session.PracticeSession
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameSession
public class PracticeSession extends AbstractGameSession
Single-player practice session: A → Z, each letter requires PerfectBonusScoringStrategy.getRequiredSuccesses() consecutive passes.

Contains only practice-specific logic. Recognition, attempt recording, and guards live in AbstractGameSession. Letter ordering is delegated to LetterProgression. All output is sent to the injected GameEventListener — no System.out calls here.

Pass condition

Must succeed consecutively REQUIRED_SUCCESSES times. Any failure resets the streak to zero and forfeits pending score for that letter.

Scoring

  attempt score  = floor(accuracy × 100) × tier
  perfect bonus  = max(0, required - failCount) × bonusPerTier × tier
  letter total   = sum of passing attempt scores + perfect bonus

    • attempt

      public AttemptRecord attempt(List<HandLandmark> userLandmarks)
      Submits a recognition attempt for the current letter.

      On success: increments streak and pending score; clears letter when streak reaches REQUIRED_SUCCESSES.
      On failure: resets streak and forfeits pending score.

      Parameters:
      userLandmarks - 21 hand landmarks from the live camera feed
      Returns:
      the AttemptRecord for this attempt
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the session is already finished
